description:
The 4StoreyBuilding project is loaded in eQUEST. You are simulating the impact of aging heating equipment. Update the 'FURNACE-HIR' (Heat Input Ratio) for all 12 Perimeter (North, South, East, West) packaged single-zone systems on the Ground, Middle, and Top floors to reflect a degraded efficiency of 72% (HIR = 1.389). 

Do NOT modify the 3 Core systems (systems with 'C' in the name, e.g., G.C05), as they are newer units. 

Steps:
1. Navigate to Air-Side HVAC.
2. Locate the 12 perimeter systems (G.N*, G.E*, G.S*, G.W*, M.N*, etc.).
3. Change their FURNACE-HIR to 1.389.
4. Ensure the 3 Core systems (G.C*, M.C*, T.C*) are unchanged.
5. Run the annual simulation.
6. Save the project.
